flagged_altitude_inconsistency.description: Check (a) altitude discrepancy exceeded; cockpit advisory warranted

jamming_degraded.description: Degraded GPS interference environment; caution advisory for position drift

insufficient.description: Insufficient telemetry points (<10) or checks (<2); system abstains

secondary_unit.note: Consecutive timetable legs stitched into continuous multi-leg airframe tracks

headline_box.title: What this can and cannot do
bullets: Altitude-consistency detector only: evaluates barometric vs geometric altimetry discrepancy (Check a).
Horizontal spoofing 0% recall: lateral track manipulation is not detected by altitude consistency.
Multi-aircraft consensus inactive: Check (d) is disabled in v0.3 and does not contribute to detection.
All results synthetic: benchmark evaluated on simulated ADS-B perturbations, not real-world air traffic.
